notes: Handwritten check marks present: Q7-C, Q8-C, Q9-B, Q10-A checked and Q10-D also has a checkmark on the English side — two different options marked on Hindi vs English for the same question (A on Hindi side, D on English side) — an inconsistency in the marks themselves, reinforcing why they are never trusted as a source (F3).
